messages.text: The clean execution pass surfaced three semantic issues rather than broad instability: `sort-by` was accidentally treated as a two-word command, a bare token at command-head position was accepted as a string instead of an external command, and punctuation such as an unquoted CSV separator was rejected. I’m fixing those boundaries and removing one invalid verifier case that invoked the real external `yes` program indefinitely; then I’ll run the byte-for-byte suite and separate renderer mismatches from evaluator mismatches.
